instruction: For each slide in the desktop PowerPoint file, insert the appropriate speaker notes using the provided notes document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires ensuring ALL 7 slides have speaker notes. Originally, slides 4, 5, 7 already have notes, so agent needs to add notes to slides 1, 2, 3, 6. Evaluator checks that all 7 slides end up with notes. Verified that PPTX has 7 slides total and notes.docx provides talking points for all slides.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts speaker notes state from all slides in the PPTX file
Getter properly checks for non-empty notes text on each slide using has_notes_slide and notes_text_frame
Metric correctly verifies that all slides have notes by comparing slides_with_notes == total_slides
Expected value correctly specifies total_slides=7, matching the actual presentation structure
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to persist any added notes before verification
Metric correctly handles the 'type: rule' expected parameter by directly accessing expected.get('total_slides')
Partial credit logic is reasonable and proportional to completion (slides_with_notes / total_slides)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction (all slides have notes)
No logical flaws or edge case gaps detected in the verification logic
